title: 5 Nts at Port Douglas Ramada inc. Flights & Bags: BNE $645, GC $656, SYD $684, MEL $708, ADL $777 (Per Person) @ Luxury Escapes
body:
Deal: 5 Nts at Port Douglas Ramada inc. Flights & Bags: BNE $645, GC $656, SYD $684, MEL $708, ADL $777 (Per Person) @ Luxury Escapes

[SnowDragon] Flights are to Cairns - I assume you have to hire a car or bus?
[Gunnar] There’s a shuttle Bus from cairns to port Douglas. We were there last year. No need for a car in PD itself but I would suggest hiring a car for a day in PD to go to the Daintree, is way better than a tour
This is a really good price. PD is on the exy side but is really great
[Captain Yobbo] Agree, head into Daintree Village, the pub is nice and take a river cruise with Bruce Belcher, one of the highlights of our trip.
[Big L] Captain Yobbo and Bruce Belcher on a trip after the pub - sounds like an adult Aussie animated sitcom
[Captain Yobbo] @Big L: Haha, he's a terrific bloke, knows everything about the flora & fauna and where to find it all on the Daintree River.
[Gunnar] @Captain Yobbo: Unfortunately Bruce passed away earlier this year
[merriweather] +1 on renting a car, beautiful drive up the coast.
[87percent] Just strap the infant to you and wear a mumu
[Fishballs] How do you actually get this price with flights and hotel together. The page takes you to a separate link for both and the jetstar flights aren't including bags.
[existence89] Yeah wondering the same. The Luxury Escapes prices aren't what's listed on the IWRF site
[IWantThatFlight] You book the flights & hotels separately (its how we are able to get the prices so cheap). Prices listed here are for Jetstar flights with 20kg bag. If you choose the flights without bags then it will be cheaper.
[tunzafun001] I couldn't see the hotel under $775 pp twin share?
So $300pn for 5 nights.
We normally use Amex credits here at $200 - $250 per night.
"PS - They will come at you guns hot for a TIMESHARE ..
[SnowDragon] Had to create a Luxury Escapes account and then see the option top right to add flights and choose location.
https://i.imgur.com/YjoIPju.png .
[existence89] Title should state per person, twin share. There's no way to get those prices solo.
[IWantThatFlight] I just updated the body text with the per-person info. Thanks for catching.
[ilikedeals] You need to update the title; otherwise misleading (price pp, based on twin share, 2 people required)
[glenf] Yes usually they charge a seperate ticket for the baby over two. While tickets are oki. Do we also have to pay for a seperate room ? Since this is twin share or an extra person ?
[tenpercent] Just say the "baby" is 23 months old. What are they gonna do? Card him/her?
[tunzafun001] The room has a sofa couch and you ask for bedding for a child when you check in. May/ may not have to pay. $30 a night officially I believe.
[ShatGPT] Yes I have to pay for my 437 month child too…
[glenf] If you had one of 437 month child and one 26 month old alongside you being atlest 400 month old child. Would you still be expected to pay for your 26month old separately! Obviously your 26month old wouldn’t be occupying a seperate room by themselves . .
Want sure why I was downvoted by people! It’s just a question for OP
[tenpercent] This is a trick question right?
The first sentence is a red herring, because the question is about a baby.
[HKS] Wish this was for the 10th to 15th of October would have been perfect
[jackary] Any ideas on price for a single? I’m alone and don’t like anybody else, thank you
[Guybrush- Threepwood] Per person, twin share prices are a bit of a joke really. Just a way to fool people into being interested in the headline price.
There is no way the price can be less than the pp x 2 price, so why bother with it. It's like advertising a 5-seater car worth $50,000 is only $10,000 (per person, 5 share).
[hi5] It is cyclone season there in summer FYI
[simonbrads] I'm confused by this deal. It's not really a package deal, is it? Flights and hotel to be booked separately. It would be clearer if the hotel were listed once, as the price must be the same regardless of where you're flying from, with the flight/hotel price split made clear. Also, the hotel price seems pretty much the same as what you can get via Booking.com or whatever. 🤷🏻
EDIT: I guess the hotel is a bit cheaper, if you factor in the food voucher, wine, bike hire…
[glenf] Ok just looked a single date and it’s cheaper on booking.com (nov10-15). If flights are seperate from Jetstar . Whats the deal here !
[HappyPants] Breakfast is probably another $30 or $40 per person per day as well? And if you don't have a car, and you're feeling lazy, and don't make good decisions when you're hungry, (like me) then you'll pay whatever the hotel is charging for brekky. Not a great deal at all really, IMO.
[tunzafun001] Dinner at the Ramada is half decently priced. Breakfast options are limited and quite exy. 2 adults and a child is difficult to get under $50.
Grab your own cereal/ milk from the Coles (or supermarkets on the way).
[jabroni] is a 1 year old going to cop the pp charge?
